notes.title: Dungeons
notes.content:
Hello everybody! Dungeons have now been released and merged into the main branch! Happy hunting!

Added features:
- 17 dungeons
- Extra monsters: Ghost, Ooze, Zombie, Fire Eye, dungeon boss
- General: including the first general power.
- Dark World: A parallel world in a sneak preview of things to come.
- Extra weapons: Low level weapons to increase low level options
- Extra maps: Random maps, new challenges and dungeon maps.
- Increased difficulty
- Improved army balance
- Controls: Move to center position with shift.

notes.title: Dungeons Beta
notes.content:
Hello everybody! A lot of content has been added to the dungeon beta branch. The beta branch now includes the following:

- 17 dungeons
- Extra monsters: Ghost, Ooze, Zombie, Fire Eye, dungeon boss
- General: including the first general power.
- Dark World: A parallel world in a sneak preview of things to come.
- Extra weapons: Low level weapons to increase low level options.
- Extra items: Potions, armour, shield, hammers.
- Extra maps: Random maps, new challenges and dungeon maps.
- Increased difficulty
- Improved army balance
- Controls: Change formation distances by dragging.

Please send your feedback so we can prepare for the dungeon release to be merged with the main branch!

notes.title: Dungeons update
notes.content:
This update has a big surprice. Follow the new quest and find out what it is! A new and strange person has settled near the village. Can you find out why he is there?

Also, a new dungeon has been added. Good luck!

tags.feature: Also, a new dungeon has been added.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
The last changes are made before the release!
- Retreat now has a loading screen
- Fixed side scrolling with dual screen.

notes.title: Minor feature update
notes.content:
New features have been added:
- A master volume control has been added.
- The adventure screen now also has a menu screen.
- Save games now show time and date.
- Some text changes.

tags.feature: - A master volume control has been added.

notes.title: Demo feature update
notes.content:
New features have been added and some balance changes:
- Increased the effectiveness of shields
- Increased the effectiveness of cloth jacket
- In planner screen, units can now be selected by hotkeys.
- In planner screen, hold the control key to quickly add items to a unit.
- During battle, the unit modus is shown on the unit status at the left of the screen.

notes.title: Minor Demo Update
notes.content:
After more testing, the following changes have been made:
- Camera rotation with middle mouse button
- Hold the control key to drag command rings
- Polishing deployment.

notes.title: Minor Demo Update
notes.content:
Thanks to the beta testers, the progress of improvement is continuing. The following changes have been made to the Demo and will be added to the original game:
- FIx to mouseover in craftsman screen.
- Camera rotation speed is halved.
- The planner will no longer work like a campfire
- Mayor changes made to the mini map

Please try the new map and give some feedback.
